fact: The Ministry of Justice dropped plans to import Congo's SIGAJ system and is relying on the e-Justice-CM project, funded with USD 10 million by the African Development Bank, with 42 court registries holding a terminal on the RJ-Secure judicial network and a target of 60 by year end.
title: BILAN 2018-2025 - Justice et État de droit : les lents progrès du système judiciaire
